figurative_meaning_en: constant state of irritation or peevish temperament
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার খিটখিটে মেজাজের জন্য কেউ তার সাথে কথা বলতে চায় না।
আজকাল সে খুব খিটখিটে হয়ে গেছে, সামান্য কথায় রেগে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: No one wants to talk to him because of his peevish temperament.
Lately, she has become very irritable and gets angry over small things.
note: This is an onomatopoeic adjective derived from sounds of grumbling or fussing in Bengali colloquial speech.
